description: nn-parity files: per shipped RPM, the relocated glibc's file set, types, modes, symlinks and partitioner metadata (nix-support/rpm/*.json: Requires/Provides from the transient headers) vs the 221 official RPMs (checks.nn-glibc-files). Generic relocation effects are in nn-default.json; every rule here names its cause in 'effect'.

allow.reason: P2 (packages/glibc/nix-patches/locale-archive.patch, design §4.3): locale and localedef call secure_getenv (GLIBC_2.17) for $LOCALE_ARCHIVE_2_27 / $LOCALE_ARCHIVE, so rpm's ELF dependency generator adds this version Requires to glibc-common's transient header; glibc-common already requires libc.so.6 with later versions from the same glibc, so the dependency closure is unchanged
